name: Paycloud Holdings Inc.
summary: arara inc. provides various technology solutions in Japan. The company engages in the development and provision of CRM services featuring reward point, e-money, and other functions for promoting ‘point+plus'; P-Pointer' data security solutions; augmented reality services, such as ‘ARAPPLI' and ‘ARAPPLI SIGNAGE'; and QR code related services covering ‘QRQR - QR Code Reader' and ‘QRQR Manager'. It also provides blockchain solutions; and offers and manages ‘arara messaging solutions', which are high-speed email delivery solutions. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
